name: HEAD-QA
intro: HEAD-QA是基于西班牙医疗系统专业资格考试的多项选择问答基准，涵盖医学、护理学、心理学、化学、药学和生物学六个领域，对人类专家也极具挑战性。
eval_feature: 复杂推理，跨语言能力，专业资格考试难度
build_method_en: Manually collected, from Spanish medical professional qualification exams
eval_feature_en: Complex reasoning, cross-lingual ability, professional qualification exam difficulty
intro_en: HEAD-QA is a multiple-choice question benchmark based on the Spanish healthcare system professional qualification exam, covering six fields: medicine, nursing, psychology, chemistry, pharmacy, and biology. It is highly challenging even for human experts.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.04701. HEAD-QA is created from Spanish public healthcare specialization examinations from 2013 onward. It covers medicine, pharmacology, psychology, nursing, biology, and chemistry; radiophysics is excluded because equations made PDF parsing difficult. Items considered invalid after the official exams are removed. Each sample stores a question ID and text, optional image path, possible answers with IDs and text, and the right-answer ID. The dataset keeps year-based official splits rather than random splits: 2013-2014 exams for training, 2015 for development, and later exams for testing, preserving comparability with official human results. The original Spanish dataset is complemented by an English translation via Google API, with adequacy and fluency checked by fluent speakers on a random sample. Evaluation is multiple-choice QA with accuracy and the official POINTS metric.
